name: Jobscan
summary: Resume scanner that checks a CV against a job description for ATS and recruiter keywords, with AI cover-letter and bullet tools on paid plans.
description: Resume scanner that checks a CV against a job description for ATS and recruiter keywords, with AI cover-letter and bullet tools on paid plans.

pricing.details: Free 0 € forever — 5 free resume scans monthly, 5 ATS and recruiter findings, job tracker, post-interview thank-you notes, resume builder and manager, Chrome extension, Jobscan Learning Center. Quarterly 27 €/month billed 81 € every 3 months, 7-day free trial, “save 40%”, for 3 months after the free trial — unlimited resume scans, unlimited AI optimizations (desktop only), AI cover-letter generator, AI bullet-point generator (desktop only), LinkedIn optimizer after the trial (desktop only), unlimited keyword comparisons and ATS/recruiter findings, AI job match, 2 free Auto Apply credits a month after the trial, 20% off Auto Apply credits and interview practice after the trial, plus ebooks and premium templates. Monthly 45 €/month billed every month — same paid feature set (the official FAQ says there is no trial period if you selected a monthly plan or opted out to gain full access to LinkedIn Optimization). Organization sign-up is offered separately.
pricing.label: Freemium
